title: 砂塵の檻と蝕の天球儀
author: 神楽坂 探

en.title: The Cage of Sand and the Eclipsed Celestial Globe
en.premise: Astronomers have been specially invited to an oasis resort in the heart of a vast desert to witness a rare total lunar eclipse—the first in decades. But the moment the moon is swallowed by shadow, the host's body is discovered within a locked observatory. All that remains at the scene is an impossibly precise celestial globe and a few stray traces of sand. Is this death, brought by the darkness, a law of nature, or a calculated intent to kill?

zh.title: 沙尘之笼与蚀之天球仪
zh.premise: 天文学家们受邀前往广袤沙漠中的一处绿洲度假村，共同见证数十年一遇的月全食。然而，就在月亮被阴影吞噬的刹那，主办者的尸体在密室般的天文台内被发现。现场仅留下一具精密得令人费解的天球仪，以及些许沙尘痕迹。这场由黑暗带来的死亡，究竟是自然的必然，还是经过精密计算的杀意？
